correctness.rationale: Unique symmetric extremal ellipsoids must be centered balls because the S_n commutant acts scalarly on the standard representation. Positive John contact vectors and uniform vertex-orbit isotropic covariance independently certify unrestricted extrema. Exact vertex squared norm yields the outer radius. Piecewise differentiation proves unique halfway optimum; two rational Taylor expansions give exact parity stability orders. Verified boundary behavior for integers and s approaching 0 or n; 9960 finite exact/numerical checks corroborate, not replace proof.

Inspected full statements do not supply the exact all-real-level unrestricted ellipsoid distortion optimization, unique midpoint minimum, and even/odd sharp stability orders together. residual_risks: The elementary symmetry and vertex-radius arguments could have appeared earlier under generalized hypersimplex, spherical roundness or rounding ratio nomenclature.
